nodes.description: Ownable.owner: address public; stores contract owner, set to msg.sender at deployment, mutated by transferOwnership.
ERC20.totalSupply: uint public declared in the ERC20 interface/base contract.
StandardToken.balances: mapping(address => uint) token balance ledger.
StandardToken.allowed: nested mapping(address => mapping(address => uint)) ERC20 allowance table.
StandardToken.frozenAccount: mapping(address => bool) public freeze flag per account.
TCSCCoin.name: string public token name set to 'TCSC' in constructor.
TCSCCoin.symbol: string public token symbol set to 'TCSC' in constructor.
TCSCCoin.decimals: uint public token decimals set to 6.
TCSCCoin.totalSupply: uint public total supply, mirrors ERC20.totalSupply and updated by mintToken/burn.
Ownable(): constructor assigning owner = msg.sender.
onlyOwner modifier: require(msg.sender == owner) before executing the guarded function body.
Ownable.transferOwnership(address newOwner): onlyOwner, writes owner when newOwner != address(0).
SafeMath.safeSub(uint a, uint b): pure internal, asserts b <= a then returns a - b.
SafeMath.safeAdd(uint a, uint b): pure internal, computes c = a + b and asserts c >= a && c >= b (overflow check).
SafeMath.sAssert(bool assertion): pure internal, reverts when assertion is false.
ERC20.balanceOf(address who) constant returns (uint): interface declaration only.
ERC20.allowance(address owner, address spender) constant returns (uint): interface declaration only.
ERC20.transfer(address toAcct, uint value) returns (bool): external interface entry point, reachable from transferAnyERC20Token.
ERC20.transferFrom(address fromAcct, address toAcct, uint value) returns (bool): interface declaration only.
ERC20.approve(address spender, uint value) returns (bool): interface declaration only.
StandardToken.transfer(address _toAcct, uint _value): moves tokens from msg.sender using safeSub/safeAdd and emits Transfer.
StandardToken.transferFrom(address _fromAcct, address _toAcct, uint _value): spends allowance of msg.sender and moves balances with safeSub/safeAdd.
StandardToken.balanceOf(address _owner) constant returns (uint balance): reads balances mapping.
StandardToken.approve(address _spender, uint _value): writes allowed[msg.sender][_spender] and emits Approval.
StandardToken.allowance(address _owner, address _spender) constant returns (uint remaining): reads allowed mapping.
StandardToken.burn(uint256 _value): burns msg.sender balance and reduces totalSupply via safeSub.
TCSCCoin() constructor: sets totalSupply, allocates all tokens to msg.sender, and initializes name/symbol/decimals.
TCSCCoin fallback function: payable, empty body, accepts ether without logic.
TCSCCoin.transferOwnership(address _newOwner): onlyOwner, moves entire token balance to the new owner and delegates to Ownable.transferOwnership.
transferAnyERC20Token(address tokenAddress, uint amount): onlyOwner, performs external call ERC20(tokenAddress).transfer(owner, amount).
freezeAccount(address target, bool freeze): onlyOwner, writes frozenAccount[target] and emits FrozenFunds.
mintToken(address _toAcct, uint256 _value): onlyOwner, increases balances/_toAcct and totalSupply via safeAdd and emits Transfer.
msg.sender used in Ownable constructor to initialize the owner state variable.
msg.sender compared with owner inside the onlyOwner modifier (authorization check).
msg.sender used as the implicit account key in StandardToken transfer/transferFrom/approve/burn.
msg.sender used in TCSCCoin constructor to receive the whole initial token supply.
Unsigned subtraction a - b guarded only by sAssert(b <= a); an underflow reverts and any unguarded variant would wrap (arithmetic).
Unsigned addition c = a + b guarded by sAssert(c >= a && c >= b); overflow condition (arithmetic) in pre-0.8 Solidity.
External call ERC20(tokenAddress).transfer(owner, amount) on an attacker-supplied token address; state is not protected by reentrancy guard (reentrancy).
